prompts.prompt: We IPO'd in June 2026 on NYSE with a $450M float and $180M revenue. When does SOX actually bite for us, and do we need the auditor attestation?
How do I figure out which systems are in scope for SOX? We run NetSuite, a custom billing engine, Workday payroll, and a data warehouse that produces revenue reports.
Our Q3 user access review just found that an IT admin who left in February still has an active ERP account with superuser privileges. Walk me through evaluating this.
Build the change-management section of our ITGC risk-and-control matrix for the billing system, including how the auditors will test it.
Design our annual SOX ITGC calendar. We're a calendar-year accelerated filer and remediation always surprises us in Q4.
